For example, Media will have its own category for their specific needs (media shuttle schedule, press center opening times etc). The organising committee will have its own information available through the app and teams all the information relevant for them. In addition to specific information, all users can have results, starting times etc available through the app.

Participants need to download the app and enter a password which will take them directly to the information according to their profile. The password will be made available from the organiser.

The organiser needs to contact Sportity Ltd for the use of the app.

Field is the easiest, fastest and secure way to book a sports venue, online.
Play easily: book and pay through the app, split the bill with the other players and access your matches’ results!

How?
It’s simple: through the app you can do it all - book, pay and play > and you are ready to go!
On top of that, we are also joining new sports!

BOOK
- Sign up and create your profile - don't forget to add a valid payment method, in order to complete and secure your booking.
- Find the right sports venue for you: through location, filters (type of game, venue characteristics and amenities) and also the date and hour at which you want to play.
- Access photos and venue details. You just have to decide where you want to play!
- Did you find your ideal sports venue? Now, it’s time to book! Create a match, invite your friends (they will receive the invites), split the bill and check the status of the invitation.
- But, we have more! Field app also generates the distribution of the teams.
- After the booking, you and the sports venue will receive a confirmation e-mail. This e-mail confirms your booking and also informs the sports venue of the date and hour the team will arrive, in order to receive you.

PAY
- To secure your booking, you must have a valid payment method: credit card or virtual card.
Additionally, we accept payments through bank reference and MB Way -  you just have to call our booking line.
- Through the app, the user will be charged at the end of the match.
- You can split the bill with your teammates and each will pay its part directly through the payment method chosen at the profile.
- Booking cancellations will be free of charge, until 48h before the match.

PLAY
- If you have already found the right sports venue for you and have completed the previous steps, you are ready to play!
- If you still haven’t decided about the pitch you’ll be playing on, compare them by prices, photos, reviews, filters or available amenities and start warming up!

REVIEW
Help us improve our service by leaving a review about the sports venue, after the match.
